messages:
Alex C: FYI perf alert from PerfBot for /v1/chat/stream — function-call validation p95 jumped from ~18ms to ~220ms around 22:06 UTC :eyes:
PerfBot: ALERT: route=/v1/chat/stream metric=function_validate_latency_p95 value=220ms threshold=100ms graph=https://grafana.redwood/alert/3287
Maria P: saw that. also noticed retries for tool calls increased in the same window, about +4x.
Jeff L: can we get a quick breakdown by token position? suspect KV cold loads on early tokens triggering expensive validation.
Sara O: timeline looks correlated with a kernel-selection rollout at 22:00 — kernel-switch -> fallback to generic kernel for some model shards.
Kyle T: confirming: rollout flags changed kernel_selector.alpha=on at 21:59:45 UTC (canary to 10%).
Alex C: hmm, if kernel change increases memory pressure it could cause KV evictions and extra validation work. any flamegraph or trace?
Jeff L: ran a short trace on a repro job, pasted key spans below:

```
span: request_recv 2ms
span: kernel_select 8ms
span: kv_cache_prefetch 30ms
span: validate_fn 190ms
span: apply_kv 6ms
span: token_generate 12ms
```

Maria P: validate_fn is the outlier. it's doing schema validation + tool arg canonicalization + retry logic for failed parsers.
Anita R: I pulled logs from one instance: saw repeated validation retries with parse errors after KV miss:
```
WARN parse_tool_args: missing_field -> retry attempt=1
WARN parse_tool_args: missing_field -> retry attempt=2
INFO validation_complete duration=188ms
```

Jeff L: interesting — could be that the kernel switch changed tokenization offsets or chunking, causing tool arg boundaries to shift and parsers to hit edge cases.
Sara O: can we reproduce locally by forcing the new kernel on a bench model and replaying the same prompt distribution?
Kyle T: yes, I can spin up a 5-instance canary with kernel_selector.alpha=true and run the failing prompt set.
Alex C: please also enable token-level latency histograms in the bench harness — we need per-token pxx and counts by route. current dashboards aggregate over full response which hides early-token validation spikes.
Maria P: created temporary panel request: per-token validate_latency histogram (0-500ms buckets) + per-route retry rate.
Jeff L: quick hack: add a short-circuit in validate_fn to skip deep canonicalization when parse error rate > 20% (for canary only) — would reduce retries but needs careful guard.
Anita R: would that risk returning malformed tool args to callers?
Jeff L: yes, but can be gated behind feature flag and only for internal traffic.
InfraBot: Deployment note: kernel-selector canary rollout paused at 22:12 UTC due to alert.
Kyle T: repro results: with kernel_selector.alpha=true, validate_fn median=42ms p95=210ms; without the flag median=17ms p95=24ms. reproduces locally.
Maria P: adding that to the incident ticket.
Alex C: next steps? I vote: 1) rollback kernel-selector.alpha -> off for canary, 2) short-term mitigate validate_fn (skip heavy canonicalization under flag), 3) instrument per-token histograms and publish per-route KPI dashboard, 4) deeper root-cause trace.
Sara O: agree. I also want kernel selector telemetry added: output selected kernel id + reason code to traces so we can correlate.
Jeff L: I'll open PR for validate_fn safeguard and a small perf-optimized parser path (no retries) behind a flag. small test vectors included.
Anita R: I'll update dashboards: token-level histograms, retry-rate heatmap by route, and a new panel showing kv_cache_eviction_rate vs validate_latency.
Kyle T: rolling back canary now.
InfraBot: Action: canary rollback started at 22:18:05 UTC by Kyle T — will take ~2m.
PerfBot: RESOLVED: alert cleared at 22:20 UTC — validate_latency_p95 returned to baseline.
Maria P: postmortem note: kernel selector changed execution path -> increased KV misses -> validation retries amplified cost of validation function. Root cause likely mismatch in token boundaries.
Alex C: thanks everyone. follow-ups: Jeff to PR validate_fn change (owner), Anita to publish new dashboards, Sara + Kyle to add kernel selector telemetry. Filing ticket: INF-4721.
Jeff L: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/7423 (wip) :thumbsup:
Anita R: dashboards posted here: https://grafana.redwood/d/validate-tooling/funccall-overhead
Sara O: I'll add kernel-selector trace fields this week and link to INF-4721.
Alex C: great, closing the thread. if anyone sees another spike please @channel and drop traces. :party-popper:
